steps.text: Please open the quest's Quest Journal to sync your state.
Talk to Brundt in Rellekka's longhall.
choices: I want to become a Fremennik!

steps.text: Talk to Olaf the Bard north east of the longhall.
Go south east of Rellekka and cut a branch from the swaying tree
Use a knife on the branch to make an unstrung lyre
Talk to Lalli to the south east of Rellekka.
Return to Rellekka and talk to Askeladden for a pet rock.
Pick a potato, cabbage and onion from the field in south east Rellekka.
Return to Lalli and use a onion, cabbage, potato, and pet rock on their stew. You can find the vegetables growing in the south east of Rellekka.
Use a cabbage on the stew.
Use a potato on the stew.
Use your pet rock on the stew.
Talk to Lalli for golden wool.
Spin the golden fleece into wool using a spinning wheel. The closest wheel is in Seers' Village.
Use the golden wool on your unstrung lyre.
Bring your lyre to the Strange Altar south west of Rellekka, and use either a raw shark, raw sea turtle or raw manta ray on it.

items.name: Raw shark, manta ray or sea turtle

steps.text: Return to Rellekka and enter the longhall's stage to perform. Once on stage, play the enchanted lyre.
Talk to Manni the Reveller in the Rellekka longhall.
Get some beer. There is beer tankard in the Rellekka longhall.
Give the Council workman on the bridge south of Rellekka going to Seer's Village a beer.
Buy some alcohol free beer from the Poison Salesman in the Seer's Village pub.
Return to Rellekka with the strange object, a tinderbox, and low alcohol beer.
Use a tinderbox on the strange object then use it on the nearby pipe.
Use the lit strange object on the nearby pipe!
Pick up a keg of beer in the longhall.
Use the low alcohol beer on the keg of beer whilst in the longhall.
Talk to Manni the Reveller to cheat in the competition.
Talk to Sigli south of the longhall for a hunters' talisman.
Use the hunter's talisman to hunt down the Draugen. It'll appear near one of the butterflies in the area.
Return the charged hunters' talisman to Sigli.

Bring the ballad to the Sailor on the docks.
Finally, bring the exotic flower to Sigmund the Merchant in the Rellekka market.
Talk to Thorvald north of the longhall.
When you're ready to fight Koschei, go down the ladder.
Wait for Koschei the Deathless to spawn. If you brought a dramen branch you should now fletch it and equip the staff.
Fight Koschei the Deathless and 'kill' him at least 3 times. Dying to his fourth phase is a SAFE death.

You must now either die (SAFE DEATH), or defeat Koschei once more. Do not leave or you'll have to fight him again.
